definitions.gloss: to progress; to advance; to proceed
definitions.explanation: For events, processes, or conditions to move forward in their course. Often implies a steady, ongoing process rather than a sudden change.

definitions.gloss: to worsen; to advance (of a disease or condition)
definitions.explanation: Specifically for diseases or deteriorating conditions that gradually become more severe.

examples.english: With early detection, cancer can be treated before it advances.

notes:
Implies steady, continuous movement forward. Unlike ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ which is a general verb for moving forward, {進行|しんこう}する specifically refers to processes, events, or conditions advancing through stages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{進行|しんこう}{方向|ほうこう}→進行方向：15973_shinkouhoukou⟧: direction of travel
- ⟦{進行|しんこう}{役|やく}→進行役：25039_shinkouyaku⟧: facilitator; emcee
- ⟦{進行|しんこう}{中|ちゅう}→進行中：21844_shinkouchuu⟧: in progress
- ⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: progressing quickly
- ⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to halt the progression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to advance; to go forward — more general; can describe physical movement
- ⟦{進展|しんてん}→進展：14374_shinten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop; to make progress — implies a positive breakthrough or advance
- ⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧: to worsen — explicitly negative; {進行|しんこう}する is more neutral even when describing disease
